$Comment: What the Horseman's Hoard (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase) pays. Every roll is
read on its own: the first has no Chance, so it always pays and the Hoard is never empty; the
three after it are the chances at his own pieces of ancient steel, each raising the Fire damage
its wearer deals; the last two are pieces of his graveyard to build with, a tombstone and a ruins
lantern like the ones that stand in it, which no recipe makes. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase
